fact: At the DGSN open days held in Tangier on 2-6 October 2019, a DGSN officer said the GESTARR police-arrondissement management system manages the complaints lodged by citizens and the issue of administrative documents (residence certificates, loss and theft declarations), that the information coming from the arrondissements is stored on a central DGSN server to follow up complaints and documents, and that it had been installed in almost all arrondissements of the Kingdom.
title: DGSN. GESTARR, le nouveau système de gestion des arrondissements de police
